entry.title: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet - Releases - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
coreunstable-1.21.0-beta.1

The following changes are from the previous release 1.20.1-beta.1.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Prometheus.AspNetCore v1.21.0-beta.1

    • Fixed OpenMetrics scrape responses containing a # UNIT line whose unit is
      not an underscore-separated suffix of the metric family name (for example
      auth.failedlogins with the unit logins), which caused scrapers such as
      Prometheus to reject the whole response. The # UNIT line is now omitted
      for such metrics; exported metric names are unchanged.
      (#7993)

    • Fixed scrapes that negotiate different response formats within the
      ScrapeResponseCacheDurationMilliseconds window each triggering their own
      metrics collection. A collection now also writes the response for other
      formats whose scrapes arrived alongside a previous collection, so scrapes
      that keep arriving together are served from the cache. Fresh cached responses
      remain available while another format is serialized, even if that
      serialization fails.
      (#7994)

    • Fixed array- and map-valued attributes being serialized as the .NET type
      name (e.g. System.Byte[], System.Int32[]) instead of being JSON-encoded
      as per the specification. byte[]-valued attributes are now
      Base64-encoded, and other array- and map-valued attributes are now
      JSON-encoded.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed arrays of string-valued key/value pairs being
      serialized as JSON arrays of strings instead of JSON objects.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed scrape clients which stop reading their response delaying other
      scrapes until ScrapeResponseTimeoutMilliseconds elapses.
      (#8041)

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    • Fixed a scrape response containing the same series (metric name and labels)
      more than once, which causes Prometheus to reject the whole response, such as
      when metric or tag names are the same once escaped, tag names become the same
      when UTF-8 encoded, or the scope information is disabled. Duplicate series are
      now dropped, and a warning event is written.
      A metric which has the name of a sample that is generated for another one
      (for example _sum of a histogram) is now dropped, and a warning event is
      written.
      (#8076)

    • An OutOfMemoryException thrown while converting an attribute value to a
      string is no longer swallowed and the attribute dropped; it now propagates.
      (#7929)

    • Updated OpenTelemetry core component version(s) to 1.21.0.
      (#8119)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Prometheus.HttpListener v1.21.0-beta.1

    • Fixed OpenMetrics scrape responses containing a # UNIT line whose unit is
      not an underscore-separated suffix of the metric family name (for example
      auth.failedlogins with the unit logins), which caused scrapers such as
      Prometheus to reject the whole response. The # UNIT line is now omitted
      for such metrics; exported metric names are unchanged.
      (#7993)

    • Fixed scrapes that negotiate different response formats within the
      ScrapeResponseCacheDurationMilliseconds window each triggering their own
      metrics collection. A collection now also writes the response for other
      formats whose scrapes arrived alongside a previous collection, so scrapes
      that keep arriving together are served from the cache. Fresh cached responses
      remain available while another format is serialized, even if that
      serialization fails.
      (#7994)

    • Fixed array- and map-valued attributes being serialized as the .NET type
      name (e.g. System.Byte[], System.Int32[]) instead of being JSON-encoded
      as per the specification. byte[]-valued attributes are now
      Base64-encoded, and other array- and map-valued attributes are now
      JSON-encoded.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed arrays of string-valued key/value pairs being
      serialized as JSON arrays of strings instead of JSON objects.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed scrape clients which stop reading their response delaying other
      scrapes until ScrapeResponseTimeoutMilliseconds elapses.
      (#8041)

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    • Fixed exporter option initialization failing when environment variable access
      is denied.
      (#8070)

    • Fixed a scrape response containing the same series (metric name and labels)
      more than once, which causes Prometheus to reject the whole response, such as
      when metric or tag names are the same once escaped, tag names become the same
      when UTF-8 encoded, or the scope information is disabled. Duplicate series are
      now dropped, and a warning event is written.
      A metric which has the name of a sample that is generated for another one
      (for example _sum of a histogram) is now dropped, and a warning event is
      written.
      (#8076)

    • An OutOfMemoryException thrown while converting an attribute value to a
      string is no longer swallowed and the attribute dropped; it now propagates.
      (#7929)

    • Reduce allocations during Accept header negotiation.
      (#8094)

    • Updated OpenTelemetry core component version(s) to 1.21.0.
      (#8119)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Shims.OpenTracing v1.21.0-beta.1

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    • Updated OpenTelemetry core component version(s) to 1.21.0.
      (#8119)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

core-1.21.0

For highlights and announcements pertaining to this release see: Release Notes > 1.21.0.

The following changes are from the previous release 1.21.0-rc.2.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry v1.21.0

    • OpenTelemetryLoggerOptions is now bound from the Logging:OpenTelemetry
      configuration section using the configuration binding source generator instead
      of reflection, making it fully trim and Native AOT compatible. An empty value
      for a boolean option is now ignored on all target frameworks rather than
      throwing on some, depending on the version of
      Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Binder in use.
      (#8100)

    • Fixed the self-diagnostics environment snapshot leaving a dangling comma in a
      redacted OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES value when it contained empty entries.
      (#8104)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Api v1.21.0

    • Update System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource dependency to 11.0.0
      for all target frameworks.
      (#8066)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Api.ProviderBuilderExtensions v1.21.0

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Console v1.21.0

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory v1.21.0

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol v1.21.0

    • Hardened the experimental disk retry feature.
      • Breaking: When running on .NET on non-Windows platforms, creating the
        exporter now throws an UnauthorizedAccessException if the retry
        directory could be changed by another user. The retry directory must be
        owned by the current user and must not be writable by its group or by
        other users. Each directory and symbolic link in its path must be owned by
        the current user or by root, and those directories must not be writable
        by their group or by other users unless they have the sticky bit set (such
        as /tmp). These checks can be disabled by setting the new
        OTEL_DOTNET_EXPERIMENTAL_OTLP_DISK_RETRY_CHECK_PERMISSIONS setting to
        false.
        (#7964)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Zipkin v1.21.0

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting v1.21.0

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Propagators v1.21.0

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.
